title: 113. Merge Intervals
prompt: Given an array of `intervals`, merge all overlapping intervals and return the disjoint result.
invariant: Sort by start; overlap iff cur[0] <= merged[-1][1]
steps: Sort `intervals` by start time and put the first interval into `merged`
For `s, e` in `intervals[1:]`: if `s <= merged[-1][1]`, extend `merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], e)`
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: Sort `intervals` by start time and put the first interval into `merged`
# Step 2: For `s, e` in `intervals[1:]`: if `s <= merged[-1][1]`, extend `merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], e)`
# Step 3: Otherwise append `[s, e]` to `merged`

hints.title: Pattern & Invariant
hints.content: Core invariant: `Sort by start; overlap iff cur[0] <= merged[-1][1]`

hints.title: Step-by-Step Plan
hints.content: Step 1: Sort `intervals` by start time and put the first interval into `merged` -> Step 2: For `s, e` in `intervals[1:]`: if `s <= merged[-1][1]`, extend `merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], e)` -> Step 3: Otherwise append `[s, e]` to `merged`

hints.title: Complexity & Edge Cases
hints.content: Aim for O(N log N) time and O(N) space. Watch empty inputs, single elements, and duplicates.
